recognize_zh: 這是一份全血球計數報告：血紅素 12.9 g/dL 與紅血球數 5.07×10^6/µL 正常，但 MCV 77.2 fL、MCH 25.4 pg 偏低，RDW 13.3% 正常，白血球與血小板正常，呈現「無貧血的單純小球性」變化。
features: WBC 7.31 ×10^3/µL with normal absolute differential; relative lymphocytosis 42.2% and Neu% 48.8% flagged
RBC 5.07 ×10^6/µL and HGB 12.9 g/dL within reference range (no anemia)
Low MCV 77.2 fL and low MCH 25.4 pg with normal MCHC 33.0 g/dL
Platelets 266 ×10^3/µL with normal MPV and indices
describe_en: Complete blood count shows a normal white cell count with a normal absolute differential (only relative neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages flagged), a normal hemoglobin of 12.9 g/dL, and a red cell count of 5.07 ×10^6/µL. Red cell indices show mild microcytosis (MCV 77.2 fL) and hypochromia (MCH 25.4 pg) with a normal MCHC and normal RDW. Platelet count and indices are normal. Isolated microcytosis without anemia and with a normal RDW is compatible with a hemoglobin variant such as Hb D trait, but coexisting thalassemia trait or early iron deficiency should be excluded with iron studies and hemoglobin analysis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency usually shows elevated RDW, a lower RBC count, and low ferritin, whereas here RDW is normal.
Thalassemia trait typically shows a higher RBC count and lower MCV (Mentzer index <13), with raised Hb A2 in beta-thalassemia trait; here the Mentzer index is about 15.
Chronic inflammation usually produces anemia with low serum iron and high ferritin, not normal hemoglobin with isolated microcytosis.
